deltas.behavior_text: The Access listener binds ':8081' inside the API container, not '127.0.0.1:8081' as task t19's recipe first said. A Docker published port forwards to the container's bridge-network address, never to the container's own loopback, so the loopback form left cloudflared's origin refusing connections and nodes.culture.dev serving a Cloudflare 502. c43's replay boundary is unchanged and rests where it always did: the host publish 127.0.0.1:18081:8081 is loopback-scoped, so no LAN interface carries the port. Fixed on the branch by the pr-upkeep loop (4221ef0); tests/deploy/nodesculturedev_test.go pins the doc's prescribed value against the publish. (PR #274 review, Qodo finding 1.)

GET /v1alpha1/tickets/{id} refuses with an error naming the page cap when either of its paged reads (runs, pending records) reaches ticketMaxPages with a cursor still outstanding, instead of returning the prefix it collected. Before this, a ticket over 10,000 runs or pending claims rendered a page that looked complete while omitting decidable records. (PR #274 review, Qodo finding 3.)

A per-run result from POST /v1alpha1/tickets/{id}/reviews carries review_id when the commit half failed after the request half succeeded, not only on 'committed'. The two are separate ledger transactions (PRD 10.8), so a writer landing between them leaves an open 'requested' review that the response previously did not name; it is now findable and retryable through POST /v1alpha1/reviews/{id}/commit. The two-step ledger contract itself is unchanged. (PR #274 review, Qodo finding 2.)
